patches.reason: Crash on QNX: cJSON_Duplicate_rec() calls itself until the stack runs out (the backtrace is cJSON_Duplicate_rec <- cJSON_Duplicate_rec <- ...). A QNX main thread gets about 464 KiB of stack unless the program is linked with qcc -N; a Linux one usually has 8 MiB. Every program is now linked with -N8M, which writes an 8 MiB stack size into its QNX ELF note.
patches.error: Memory fault (SIGSEGV) in cJSON_Duplicate_rec, deep recursion
